summary: One-session private voice crash trail and optional Android noise suppression, retaining the existing offline Parakeet 110M recognizer.

changes.title: Find the failure stage in a real private voice session
changes.detail: BR Brain can arm one blue-mic attempt and store only bounded fixed-code processing stages/timings during microphone setup, model loading, speech decoding and completion. Android's own sanitized process-exit category may reveal a crash on the next launch. No raw audio, transcript, app/editor identity, trace or automatic upload; explicit copy and erase.

changes.title: Optional Android microphone noise reduction
changes.detail: A new BR Brain ON/OFF switch tries the phone's built-in NoiseSuppressor on the existing 16-kHz blue offline microphone stream. Unsupported devices keep the original audio. The effect is released after each recording and its state is displayed honestly, without claiming an unmeasured accuracy gain. GTCRN remains native-isolated after the owner observed EXIT_SELF/255 during model loading.

changes.title: Refuse blue dictation when Android reports an active call
changes.detail: The blue microphone refuses to start or pre-warm the speech recognizer during phone/video communication mode, preserving normal typing and call responsiveness. Android's audio-input sharing is not assumed to prevent every concurrent recording.

changes.title: Existing 110M recognizer and BR Brain intelligence preserved
changes.detail: Following the owner's newest request, this update retains Parakeet TDT 110M and the existing native keyboard/Emoji learners. It does not download/bundle the larger 0.6B model, delete old weights, invent a trained Hinglish ContextLM, add Internet permissions or change signing identity.
